preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(x, int) and x >= 0 for x in [T]) and all(isinstance(x, int) and 0 <= x <= 10**6 for x in [A, B, C]) and (A + B + C >= 1)
preconditions.description: T is a positive integer (1 ≤ T ≤ 1000), and for each test case, A, B, C are non-negative integers (0 ≤ A, B, C ≤ 10^6) with at least one element in the multiset (A + B + C ≥ 1).

preconditions.expression: stdin.strip().split() and all(line.strip().split() for line in stdin.strip().splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: Input is well-formed: first line is T, followed by T lines of three space-separated integers A, B, C.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip().splitlines() == ['YES' if (A * 1 + B * 2 + C * 3) % 2 == 0 and (A + B + C) > 0 else 'NO' for line in stdin.strip().splitlines()[1:] for A, B, C in [tuple(map(int, line.strip().split()))]]
postconditions.description: For each test case, output 'YES' if and only if the total sum of the multiset (A*1 + B*2 + C*3) is even (ensuring a possible partition into two equal-sum groups) and the multiset is non-empty (A + B + C > 0).
